mostWorthwhile.text: Following recovered iron into new red blood cells was most worthwhile: it connected recycling old cells to making their oxygen-carrying protein.

leastWorthwhile.text: The skin combination was straightforward and the only action offered at that point, so it felt less like a meaningful choice, although the result was clear.

surprise.text: I didn't expect the recovered iron to travel in blood on proteins before reaching the marrow.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt arbitrary: both pairings had a clear purpose from the goals and pictures, though the compatible options supplied the pairings.

continue.text: I would probably continue for another chapter: following the iron through recycling and into new cells made me curious about other connections in the body.
